    Returns:
    pandas.DataFrame: Processed dataframe with only US entries labeled as "Domestic"
    """
    
    # Read the Excel file
    df = pd.read_excel(file_path)

    us_states = [

    ]
    
    # Common variations of US identifiers

    df_us[location_column] = 'Domestic'
    
    return df_us

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        print("Usage: python analyze.py <xlsx_file>")
        sys.exit(1)
    
    file_path = sys.argv[1]
    try:
        processed_data = process_xlsx(file_path)
        output_file = "processed_" + file_path
        processed_data.to_excel(output_file, index=False)
        print(f"Processing complete. Output saved to {output_file}")
